topic: no compatibility-alias leftovers when extracting a shared module
lesson: When extracting shared code (e.g. the jszip guard into workbook-guard.ts), DELETE the old parser-specific names - do NOT re-export them as compatibility aliases. sap-actuals.parser.ts re-exports WorkbookArchiveLimitError as SapActualsArchiveLimitError and WorkbookRowLimitError as SapActualsRowLimitError; the no-compatibility-leftovers rule (ponytail) forbids this. Remove both re-exports and update every caller (sap-actuals.parser.ts internal throws/instanceof AND sap-actuals.parser.test.ts) to import and use WorkbookArchiveLimitError / WorkbookRowLimitError directly from ./workbook-guard.
